title_en: Anthropomorphism According to Ibn Taymiyya and His Followers (Episode 4)
description_en: Anthropomorphism According to Ibn Taymiyya and His Followers (Episode 4), from the program Al-Tawhid by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: An analytical lecture investigating anthropomorphic concepts found within the works of Ibn Taymiyya and his followers.
